**MTH 256 — Quiz 3 Preparation**

Due: Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 11:59:59 p.m. America/Los_Angeles (PST).

Professor Pat’s announcement:

> Hi All,
>
> I posted Written Homework 4 and WebWork 4. Problems 1 and 2 of Written Homework 4 and 1-9 of the WebWork 4 relate to material that will be assessed on Quiz 3 which has been pushed back to week 7.
>
> Best,
>
> Pat

Study scope: the 15 topics mapped to Written Homework 4 problems 1–2 and WebWork 4 problems 1–9, plus all their prerequisite ancestors that are in your saved targets. All 105 topics are included in global layer order, including topics already studied. Each item links to its topic for study or review.
